subject: Marketplace listing: co-sell eligibility + branding & support SLA clarifications
messages:
From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@cloudforge.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing draft + co-sell ask

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for sending over the initial listing text. Our marketplace team has a couple of blocking items before we can enable co-sell on the listing:

- Branding: AWS requires the listing product name not to include partner-only trademarks in headline. The phrase “Redwood Inference — Enterprise Accelerator" may be flagged. They want the product name to be neutral and put the Redwood mark in the logo assets/credits.
- Claims: CloudForge legal flagged two capability claims ("sub-ms latency at 2k tokens" and "multi-region auto-failover") — they want validated telemetry or toned-down language.
- Support / SLA: To qualify for co-sell the customer-facing listing must call out 24/7 enterprise support for Production plan with an explicit P1 response SLA (1 hour) and an escalation matrix.

I attached our suggested edits (marketplace-draft-copy-v1.docx) and a support matrix template (support-sla-matrix.xlsx). Can your team confirm: do we already have operational telemetry to back the latency claim? If not, can Marketing remove the hard number and replace with a more conservative phrase? Also requesting a primary escalation contact for co-sell enablement.

Priya
Partner Programs — CloudForge

---
Attachment: marketplace-draft-copy-v1.docx (docx)
Attachment: support-sla-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing draft + co-sell ask

Hi Priya —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers from our side:

- Branding: happy to remove the long-form product tagline from the listing title and move "Redwood Inference" to the publisher field + add the updated logo pack. Laura, attaching the standard logo zip we publish for marketplaces.
- Claims: we do not yet have a public telemetry audit that proves the specific 2k-token median latency under all load shapes. Recommend we change the claim to: "optimized for low-latency production inference" and then surface a performance profile PDF on request.
- Support / SLA: we can commit to an enterprise P1 1-hour response for Dedicated customers (per reserved contract). For Marketplace-enabled quick-start plans we offer business-hours support with 4-hour P1 response. If co-sell requires the 24/7 coverage on the listing, we need to ensure our operations team is on-call for Marketplace trial customers or clarify that 24/7 is for paid Enterprise tier only.

Action items:
1) Laura to prepare updated logo and short product title.
2) Karthik to confirm which plan(s) we can tie to 24/7 P1 SLA and provide name/email for escalation.
3) Marissa to draft language that removes the specific latency number and references the performance profile.

I can join a short sync with CloudForge if helpful.

Rishi
Head of Partner GTM — Redwood Inference

Thanks — I've uploaded a trimmed product title and two logo variants to the shared Drive link (see related links). Per the AWS style guide: product titles should be <= 75 characters and not include partner descriptors. I made two options:

Option A: "Redwood Inference"
Option B: "Redwood Inference — Managed Inference" (longer, might still be ok if we avoid trademark words)

Also attached a cleaned archive (logo-redwood-standards.zip) with vector and monochrome variants. Priya, let me know which they prefer and I can update the marketplace copy.

On the SLA front, Karthik, we need the canonical answer. If we only offer 24/7 P1 on Dedicated/reserved contracts, we must be explicit in the listing: "24/7 enterprise support available for dedicated plans; business-hours support for trial and self-serve." That should appease co-sell while staying truthful.

Laura
Head of Marketing — Redwood Inference

Folks —

Short version on support: we can commit to the following and it's consistent with our operational capabilities:

- Dedicated (Reserved) customers: 24/7 monitoring, P1 response target = 1 hour, named escalation contact (on-call rotations provided).
- Enterprise (Contracted via marketplace private offer): 24/7 support optional per contract; default enterprise add-on will include the 1 hour P1 SLA.
- Self-serve/Free trial marketplace listings: Business-hours support only, P1 response target = 4 hours.

I will provide the on-call escalation name and a generic PagerDuty escalation link by EOD tomorrow. For co-sell, we should draft the listing language that clearly maps support features to the plan tiers to avoid misinterpretation.

Karthik
Director, Service Ops — Redwood Inference
